propositions: The config key verify.overlap_enabled has a misleading name that describes internal mechanism rather than user-visible behavior (link suggestions), causing operators to misunderstand its purpose and impact.

The key is undocumented in docs/config.md (zero occurrences of 'overlap'), leaving operators unaware of LLM token costs that scale with tracker size, despite existing architecture documentation in docs/adr/0037-cross-ticket-overlap.md.

The rename to verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets requires permanent backward-compatibility aliases for both the TOML key and environment variable to preserve existing project configurations without breaking changes.

Existing code at two call sites (src/rebar/llm/enrich_drain.py:233 and src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:765) must be updated to use the new canonical name, and the repository's own rebar.toml configuration must also be updated.

The permanent-alias machinery (config _ALIASES dict, _LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES map, and two _deprecations registry rows) already exists and tested, so the change requires only data entry without new mechanisms.

The rename must be accompanied by a docs/config.md entry explaining what the setting produces (link suggestions), its advisory nature (never blocks), its cost model (scales with tracker size), and the related algorithm tuning keys under [tool.rebar.llm].
